title: Grateful Dead Live at Three Rivers Stadium on 1995-06-30
lineage: Transfer: Nakamichi Cassette Deck 1>Sound Devices 722> Adobe Aud 3.0>Cdwav>flac 16(TLH) Release date: 07/08/2019
source: Source: Audio Technica 835b>Sony D5 Location: OTS, Stand at 9 feet

ai_review.summary: A solid early‑90s performance with a pleasant stadium sound, though recording details are vague and listener opinions are split.
ai_review.review: The concert captures the Dead during the transitional period after Brent Mydland’s death, delivering a "cool" stadium sound that many fans enjoyed. While one reviewer gave it four stars for the vibe and venue, another rated it low and recommends a different show, leaving the overall impression mixed and the recording quality undefined.

ai_rating.rationale: Based on two reviews (one positive, one negative) with limited technical detail; show is viewed positively but recording quality is uncertain, resulting in a moderate overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers mention the stadium sounded good and the sound was "cool," but provide no concrete details about clarity, mix balance, or source type.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Listeners note the show felt like a refreshing change from typical RFK/JFK stadium gigs and praised the overall vibe despite the lineup transition.

band_member_comments.Keys: Mention of the keyboard transition year (Brent to Vince and Bruce) with a "really cool" sound.
